rules.name: Normalize and validate headers
rules.detail: Trim outer whitespace and case-fold header labels. Reject duplicate, missing, or unknown labels; column order may vary.

rules.name: Trim cell whitespace
rules.detail: Trim outer whitespace from every cell and record each changed cell. Keep the original source file unchanged.

rules.name: Validate required fields and types
rules.detail: Require order_id, order_date, region, product, category, quantity, and unit_price. Dates must be YYYY-MM-DD, quantity a positive whole number, and unit_price a positive decimal with no more than two fractional digits. Invalid rows are quarantined.

rules.name: Quarantine duplicate order IDs
rules.detail: Keep the first otherwise-valid occurrence of each order_id. Quarantine later otherwise-valid repeats; never merge or discard them silently.

rules.name: Derive line totals exactly
rules.detail: Calculate line_total as quantity multiplied by unit_price using Decimal arithmetic. Do not round or fill missing inputs.
